WITH filtered_inbound_items AS ( SELECT DISTINCT cii.contract_number, cii.contract_code, cii.contract_type, MIN(cii.display_delivery) AS display_delivery, MAX(cii.create_time) AS latest_create_time FROM ${dynamicTableNameProxy.collaborateInboundItem} cii WHERE cii.delete_flag = false AND cii.enterprise_code = #{enterpriseCode}
AND cii.contract_number ILIKE '%' || #{requestData.contractNumber} || '%'
AND ( -- 销售合同：关联销售订单产品表查询交期 (cii.contract_type = 0 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ${dynamicTableNameProxy.sellOrder} so INNER JOIN ${dynamicTableNameProxy.sellOrderProduct} sop ON so.primary_key = sop.sell_order_code WHERE so.sell_contract = cii.contract_code AND so.delete_flag = false AND sop.delete_flag = false AND sop.product_deliver_str IS NOT NULL AND sop.product_deliver_str != ''
AND sop.product_deliver_str >= TO_CHAR(#{requestData.startTime}::timestamp, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND sop.product_deliver_str <= TO_CHAR(#{requestData.endTime}::timestamp, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
LIMIT 1 )) OR -- 采购合同：从采购合同表的产品详情JSON中查询交期 (cii.contract_type = 1 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ${dynamicTableNameProxy.purchaseContract} pc WHERE pc.primary_key = cii.contract_code AND pc.delete_flag = false AND ( -- 从 product_detail JSON 字段中提取第一个产品的交期 (pc.product_detail IS NOT NULL AND pc.product_detail != '' AND
COALESCE( (pc.product_detail::jsonb -> 'products' -> 0 ->> 'deliveryDate')::text, (pc.product_detail::jsonb -> 'details' -> 0 ->> 'deliveryDate')::text ) >= TO_CHAR(#{requestData.startTime}::timestamp, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND
COALESCE( (pc.product_detail::jsonb -> 'products' -> 0 ->> 'deliveryDate')::text, (pc.product_detail::jsonb -> 'details' -> 0 ->> 'deliveryDate')::text ) <= TO_CHAR(#{requestData.endTime}::timestamp, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
) OR -- 如果 product_detail 为空，尝试从 temp_data 中提取 (pc.temp_data IS NOT NULL AND pc.temp_data != '' AND
COALESCE( (pc.temp_data::jsonb -> 'productDetails' -> 'products' -> 0 ->> 'deliveryDate')::text, (pc.temp_data::jsonb -> 'productDetails' -> 'details' -> 0 ->> 'deliveryDate')::text ) >= TO_CHAR(#{requestData.startTime}::timestamp, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND
COALESCE( (pc.temp_data::jsonb -> 'productDetails' -> 'products' -> 0 ->> 'deliveryDate')::text, (pc.temp_data::jsonb -> 'productDetails' -> 'details' -> 0 ->> 'deliveryDate')::text ) <= TO_CHAR(#{requestData.endTime}::timestamp, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
) ) LIMIT 1 )) )
GROUP BY cii.contract_number, cii.contract_code, cii.contract_type ) SELECT fi.contract_number, fi.contract_code, fi.contract_type, fi.display_delivery, so.primary_key AS sell_order_code, so.collaborate_latest_process AS collaborate_latest_process, so.contract_remark as remark FROM filtered_inbound_items fi LEFT JOIN ${dynamicTableNameProxy.sellOrder} so ON fi.contract_code = so.sell_contract -- 假设销售订单表中的关联字段是 contract_code
and so.collaborate_latest_process in
#{pro}
ORDER BY fi.latest_create_time DESC

WITH apply_summary AS ( SELECT data_key, COALESCE(SUM(apply_num), 0) AS apply_num_sum FROM ${dynamicTableNameProxy.inStockApply} WHERE delete_flag = false AND contract_code = #{requestData.contractCode} GROUP BY data_key ) SELECT t2.unity_no AS unityNo, t2.product_part_sign, t2.model, t.order_quantity, t3.pieces_sign AS pcsChn, COALESCE(a.apply_num_sum, 0) AS applyNum, t.inbound_quantity, t4.shipping_space, t4.total_inventory, t4.lock_in_inventor, t4.primary_key AS stockCode, t.primary_key, t4.stock_init_state, t.contract_number FROM ${dynamicTableNameProxy.collaborateInboundItem} t LEFT JOIN apply_summary a ON t.primary_key = a.data_key LEFT JOIN ${dynamicTableNameProxy.productPart} t2 ON t.collaborate_material = t2.primary_key LEFT JOIN ${dynamicTableNameProxy.productPiece} t3 ON t2.pcs = t3.primary_key LEFT JOIN ${dynamicTableNameProxy.stock} t4 ON t2.primary_key = t4.product_part_code WHERE t.delete_flag = false AND t.enterprise_code = #{enterpriseCode} AND t.contract_code = #{requestData.contractCode} ORDER BY t.create_time DESC,t.collaborate_type asc

SELECT t.order_quantity, t.inbound_quantity, t4.shipping_space, t4.total_inventory, t4.lock_in_inventor, t4.primary_key AS stockCode, t.primary_key, t4.stock_init_state, t.contract_number FROM ${dynamicTableNameProxy.collaborateInboundItem} t LEFT JOIN ${dynamicTableNameProxy.stock} t4 ON t.collaborate_material = t4.product_part_code WHERE t.delete_flag = false AND t.enterprise_code = #{enterpriseCode} AND t.collaborate_material = #{productPartCode} AND (t.inbound_quantity IS NULL OR t.inbound_quantity < t.order_quantity) ORDER BY t.create_time DESC LIMIT 1
